response.rationale: The tumor is a smooth-muscle neoplasm with FH loss and a pathogenic germline FH variant, which together establish hereditary leiomyomatosis and renal cell cancer (HLRCC). R2 captures the leiomyoma morphology but not the syndromic diagnosis, while R1 relies only on imaging suggesting ovarian origin and does not explain the FH abnormality.

rejected.why: Only supported by MRI suggesting an ovarian primary; the FH loss and pathogenic FH variant indicate HLRCC rather than an isolated ovarian leiomyoma.
Describes the leiomyomatous morphology but omits the FH global loss and pathogenic FH germline variant that define HLRCC.
